name: Survey for AI
purpose: Turn domain literature into queryable, versioned, evidence-bounded knowledge for AI readers.

stages.gate: Explicit scope/cutoff, identity unit, budget and role-aware completion criteria.
No title-only merge; versions and unresolved identities retained.
Primary-body locators for admitted technical claims; metadata-only and unknown remain labeled.

stages.output: branch tree and typed relationship graph
stages.gate: Valid endpoints; technical inheritance has two-endpoint support; grouping and chronology labeled separately.

stages.output: vertical, horizontal, mechanism, frontier and reader modules
stages.gate: Each module resolves its claim IDs, comparison conditions, limits and open gaps.
Exact claim permissions and citations, partial answers or abstention beyond evidence.
Input/output hashes, dependency repair, membership conservation and no silent gate relaxation.

evidence_permissions.primary_body_reviewed: only the reviewed role or claim
evidence_permissions.curator_comparison: explicit synthesis, not a new experiment

view_contract.vertical: branch navigation plus typed evolutionary edges
view_contract.mechanism: inputs/mechanism/outputs/conditions; iterative state only when applicable
view_contract.frontier: latest observed inside frozen scope/cutoff, including tied leaves
view_contract.qa: answer contract with support, limits and abstention

transfer_status: One worked RSI domain; cross-domain schema portability is implemented, effectiveness not yet established by controlled trials.
